requirements.title: Application Registration With Fixed Period
requirements.description: The SCH library shall register applications with a fixed period at startup.
requirements.rationale: PM-mandated static TDM model: every application has a compile-time period set during initialization.

requirements.title: Static Schedule After Initialization
requirements.description: The SCH library shall reject application registration after scheduler initialization completes.
requirements.rationale: PM decision SW-REQ-SYS-010: schedule is fixed at compile time; no dynamic registration permitted after init.

requirements.title: Periodic Application Invocation
requirements.description: The SCH library shall invoke each registered application at its registered period.
requirements.rationale: Core TDM behavior: apps run on their fixed cadence so sensor and nav rates are met deterministically.

requirements.title: Period Range Covers FSW Application Rates
requirements.description: The SCH library shall support application periods spanning at least 5 milliseconds to 500 milliseconds.
requirements.rationale: Constrains the static schedule (SW-REQ-SYS-010) to cover all FT1 app rates: IMU 200 Hz (SYS-005), altimeter 20 Hz (SYS-008), GPS 5 Hz (SYS-009), nav 100 Hz (SYS-012), and telemetry 2 Hz (SYS-019).

requirements.title: Deterministic Invocation Order
requirements.description: The SCH library shall invoke applications in a deterministic order on every scheduler cycle.
requirements.rationale: PM-required determinism (SW-REQ-SYS-044) so Trick simulation and flight runs are repeatable.

requirements.title: Scheduler Continues After Application Failure
requirements.description: The SCH library shall continue invoking other registered applications when one application returns a failure status.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: app failures must not halt the scheduler; other apps continue running per SW-REQ-SYS-062.

requirements.title: Application Lifecycle Start Invocation
requirements.description: The SCH library shall invoke each registered application's start hook once before its first periodic invocation.
requirements.rationale: Required so apps initialize internal state once before periodic processing begins per LibJuno app lifecycle.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The SCH library shall produce equivalent application invocation sequences on POSIX and Pico2 builds.
requirements.rationale: PM-required POSIX/Pico2 equivalence (SW-REQ-SYS-043) so Trick simulation exercises identical scheduling paths.

requirements.title: Scheduler Capacity Bounded At Compile Time
requirements.description: The SCH library shall enforce a compile-time bound on the number of registered applications.
requirements.rationale: PM constraint: no dynamic memory allocation; capacity must be a compile-time constant per SW-REQ-SYS-050.

requirements.title: Caller-Owned Scheduler Storage
requirements.description: The SCH library shall use only caller-provided storage and shall not allocate memory dynamically.
requirements.rationale: PM NFR (SW-REQ-SYS-050): no dynamic allocation after boot; all storage caller-owned per LibJuno pattern.
